local_checks.result: createHostGuard (server/src/middleware/allowed-hosts.ts:48-86, mounted first at server/src/app.ts:126) is opt-in via ALLOWED_HOSTS (server/src/lib/config.ts:69-75, 108-115) for LAN/reverse-proxy compatibility; when enabled, Node HTTP rejects duplicate Host headers and hostGuard checks hostnameOf(req.headers.host) against loopback plus configured names before Helmet/CORS/parsers/routing (hardening note: hostnameOf uses new URL('http://' + hostHeader) at allowed-hosts.ts:35, which ignores userinfo such as foo@localhost). TRUST_PROXY defaults to false (server/src/lib/config.ts:122-134; server/src/app.ts:119). isHttpsRequest (server/src/app.ts:96-101) reads x-forwarded-proto regardless of TRUST_PROXY, but only toggles upgrade-insecure-requests, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, and Origin-Agent-Cluster on the requester's own response with no shared cache key or auth impact. CORS (server/src/app.ts:130-133, 204-208) uses exact Set membership against localhost defaults and DASHBOARD_ORIGINS without Access-Control-Allow-Credentials.
